_: Classes that a route uses and no sheet it loads defines, which are nevertheless deliberate. Every entry needs a reason: `node tools/check-styles.js` prints them beside the token, and a token with no reason would be indistinguishable from an oversight. If a rule can be written, write the rule — this file is for class names that are hooks, or that live in code nothing can reach yet.

/game.ripple: Written by medieval-effects.js on click; nothing styles it, so the element is 0x0 and the effect is a no-op. Styling it is a design decision about a decoration, not a fix, so the audit reports it rather than inventing rules for UI nobody asked for.
/game.notification-toast: The toast API in medieval-effects.js. Nothing in the repo calls window.medievalEffects.showToast (verified by grep across public/, app/ and lib/), and no sheet defines the class, so this is unreachable markup rather than a broken screen.
/game.toast-header: Part of the unreachable toast markup in medieval-effects.js — see notification-toast.
/game.toast-icon: Part of the unreachable toast markup in medieval-effects.js — see notification-toast.
/game.toast-message: Part of the unreachable toast markup in medieval-effects.js — see notification-toast.
/game.toast-close: Part of the unreachable toast markup in medieval-effects.js — see notification-toast.
/game.fade-in: A state class on the unreachable toast in medieval-effects.js — see notification-toast.
/game.page-transition-overlay: The page-transition API in medieval-effects.js. Unreachable and unstyled: the class is built inside a helper nothing calls.
/game.transition-content: Part of the unreachable page transition — see page-transition-overlay.
/game.transition-icon: Part of the unreachable page transition — see page-transition-overlay.
/game.transition-text: Part of the unreachable page transition — see page-transition-overlay.
/game.medieval-loader: The loader API in medieval-effects.js. Unreachable and unstyled; the game's real loading cover is #mapLoadingGate in the game body, which is styled in theme.css.
/game.loader-ring: Part of the unreachable medieval loader — see medieval-loader.
/game.loader-center: Part of the unreachable medieval loader — see medieval-loader.
